title: Trusted-host publication resources with independently verified Nitro runtime originals

configuration.$comment: Requires the actual same cold worker's independently admitted runtime verifier owner. Only its public policy/key/checkpoint projection enters the publication bootstrap. The fixed publication job verifies the existing full signed Nitro runtime result and startup receipt/role originals before signing. Key custody, filesystem durability and rollback boundaries remain trusted-host-local; no runtime seed is transferred or TEE custody inferred. Four original distinct inherited descriptor, checkpoint and journal requirements are unchanged. No fallback to v1 or caller-supplied verification verdict is allowed.
